verdict.comment: He's a 9yo now but DR RIO could run around here with his eyes shut and he did well to go close over an inadequate trip last time.

comments.archlegend: Runner-up over C&D last month but poor runs on either side of that
comments.drrio: Close up here last month after starting slowly and this longer trip is a better fit
comments.edvardgrieg: Close third in a classified race last time and second won easily at that level on Saturday
comments.foresthaze: Ten defeats include three for her current yard and overall profile is none too compelling
comments.inspiringspeeches: Beaten in the region of 5l in two runs for this yard, both here; shouldn't be far away.
comments.jamih: A 10yo now and he trailed home last here a month ago after 225 days away
comments.lawmansblis: Won over hurdles in March; also capable on the Flat but made quiet stable debut on the AW
comments.lednikov: Most wins and best form on the AW, particularly at Southwell; poor latest run on Tapeta
comments.sisterandbrother: Has won three times since last June but none too consistent and been off for two months

races.raceComment: archlegend is marginally preferred with a score of 53.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over drrio. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This may be a good opportunity for NEPTUNE LEGEND on his first start back from wind surgery, the stable having won this race last year.

comments.coiled: Modest since returning for this yard in April and now 0-14 after Chepstow on Monday
comments.desertbeauty: Not built on a promising handicap debut, but she remains unexposed so not discounted
comments.liege: Twice finished third last summer, but not matched that form since and now 0-15
comments.myboyharry: 0-9; but went close last time and comes into this in better form than many
comments.myboyjack: 3-66 but often placed as when second at Yarmouth 12 days ago; player on that form
comments.neptunelegend: Has undergone wind surgery since last seen; respected back at this level
comments.perfectparole: 1-13 for Tom Ward; respected down in grade on stable debut
comments.spinningdancer: Out of the frame in eight starts including when behind Perfect Parole here this month

races.raceComment: neptunelegend is marginally preferred with a score of 45.3%. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Preference is for CLOUDY ROSE who has won three times over C&D and remains on the same mark as when last successful.

comments.cloudyrose: 3-10 over C&D; high on the list for stable that won this in 2016 and 2018
comments.fightingpoet: Both wins came here last year, but he does need to step up on recent efforts
comments.frenchmartini: Record under David Dunsdon reads 3241; back in calmer waters now; respected
comments.headshot: Tries this far for the first time on his 49th start; has something to prove
comments.roidebaviere: Now 0-19 under rules and has plenty to prove
comments.thronehall: Won twice under Brodie Hampson (one on Jersey) in April, but only fifth last time; chance

races.raceComment: fightingpoet is marginally preferred with a score of 49.0%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more progressive over cloudyrose. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Draw bias varies by track and conditions

verdict.comment: Preference is for MARLAY PARK, who ran a big race in defeat on his seasonal debut and will find this easier than his latest assignment.

comments.billymill: Recent turf runs were perfectly respectable but he's much more prolific on AW surfaces
comments.byzantineempress: Ran well on both 7f starts this season; dangerous here if aided by new cheekpieces
comments.extrication: Failed to build upon encouraging seasonal debut when down the field last month; now 0-11
comments.followyourheart: Nine-time AW winner who recently exploited his lower turf mark; player under 4lb penalty
comments.landofmagic: Made all against favoured nearside rail at Lingfield last month; on career-high mark now
comments.marlaypark: Not disgraced in valuable Epsom contest on Oaks day; might be the answer here
comments.mistermojito: Has won three of his last four, and latest 3lb rise does not look excessive; respected
comments.silvertrumpet: Placed on seasonal debut in March but yet to build on that effort; had recent wind op
comments.stratocracy: Placed on all three starts this season (7f-1m); likely to be in the shake-up again
comments.strike: Largely consistent 7yo who has made the frame on all four appearances this year (6f/7f)
comments.tintoretto: Seen only once since May 2023 and is now a 10yo; current ability hard to gauge
comments.windsorpass: Has very modest 1-37 strike-rate but scores high marks for her consistency; in the mix

races.raceComment: mistermojito is marginally preferred with a score of 53.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over followyourheart. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Excellent course form of 5/15 at newbury. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Alan King's BLUE TEMPUS can make a winning start to his hurdles career at the main expense of Manyana Blue.

comments.bluetempus: Six-race Flat maiden who improved in 1m2f handicaps this spring; likely type for hurdles.
comments.bobthebandit: Placed on the Flat but stamina is a major concern on hurdle debut; absent 220 days
comments.manyanablue: Five-race Flat maiden who is worth considering on hurdle debut.
comments.marrakeshdawn: Pulled up on this month's hurdle debut and hard to recommend.
comments.newgolddream: Related to winners and has had wind surgery, but others appeal more on his hurdle debut.
comments.returnwithgold: Dual AW Flat winner; modest hurdle debut but may improve on that back on quicker ground.
comments.rivermoon: Half-brother to useful Flat winners but probably best watched on debut; tongue tied.
comments.silkandsteel: Low-level form on Flat up to 1m3f but hurdles may suit for a respected stable.

races.raceComment: returnwithgold is marginally preferred with a score of 38.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over manyanablue. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 1 attempts. Excellent course form of 2/7 at newton-abbot, though step up in class and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: The most obvious answer is BYZANTIUM, who got his career firmly back on track with an emphatic handicap win three weeks ago.

comments.beaugold: Showed only minor promise when a big-priced outsider for first two hurdle runs
comments.byzantium: Back in a novice race after comfortable handicap win at Warwick three weeks ago
comments.goldenecho: Low-grade Flat winner who has taken pretty well to hurdling; each-way claims at least
comments.kentuckybluegrass: 0-9 over hurdles; a minor role is probably his best hope on these terms
comments.killthegroove: Kept on for third on hurdling debut at Market Rasen; can collect more prize-money here
comments.needtoknow: Placed in the first of three Irish points; best watched on rules debut
comments.suretobesure: Had excuse when pulled up on hurdling debut but earlier bumper form was poor
comments.timetobite: Late-maturing 10yo who won three good-ground chases this spring; first hurdle since 2022

races.raceComment: byzantium is marginally preferred with a score of 59.5%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over timetobite. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Excellent course form of 2/6 at newton-abbot. Key attributes include superior ratings and positive comments and improving, though step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Having taken an immediate step forward after wind surgery to win here, KEEL STRAND looks fairly treated for his handicap debut.

comments.borderline: 0-11 over hurdles but a promising third here post wind op and the longer trip may suit.
comments.danzini: Dual hurdle winner; below best since Fontwell win but worth a look back up in trip.
comments.dearralphy: Consistent 9yo, runner-up last four starts but will likely prove vulnerable to improvers.
comments.dorrellspierji: Running well in points this year but this is harder back over hurdles off top weight.
comments.gateaudemiel: Back-to-back chase efforts are solid and reverts to hurdles off same mark; should go well.
comments.iloveyousivola: Snapped a run of non-completions over C&D latest, but stamina looked tested.
comments.jacksjury: Improved upped to 3m on latest two starts and another bold showing can be expected.
comments.keelstrand: Fairly treated for handicap debut after winning here latest, should his stamina hold up.
comments.piratestale: Failed to complete in points this year and fared no better on rules return/stable debut.
comments.presentingyeats: Form has dipped since April's Stratford win off 2lb lower and he needs to find some spark.
comments.spitalfield: Inconsistent since last spring's win, but close to best when second at Worcester latest.

races.raceComment: gateaudemiel is marginally preferred with a score of 57.1%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more reliable profile over dorrellspierji. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
